description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git extension commands, particularly focusing on remote 'connect' helpers and their behavior with different scenarios including cloning, tagging, and connecting to a git daemon. It contains multiple test cases defined with 'test_expect_success' to verify various functionalities of the extension commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes a sequence of shell commands as part of the test.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timing or simulates a tick for test synchronization.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or strings for test validation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test suite.
